"""Randomised schema-conformance and robustness checks."""
import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from harness import run_raw

CASE_KEYS = {'name','stream','state','at','frames','request_frames','payload_bytes','sent',
             'received','response_frames','response_body','origin_count','flags'}
CHAN_KEYS = {'name','bytes','requests','committed','error'}
REQ_KEYS = {'start','end','method','target','host','host_count','headers','body','trailers',
            'framing','owner','owners','flags'}
FP_KEYS = {'n','h'}
FAIL = []

def fp_ok(v):
    return type(v) is dict and set(v) == FP_KEYS and type(v['n']) is int and v['n'] >= 0 \
        and type(v['h']) is str and len(v['h']) == 16 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in v['h'])

def check_doc(doc, out):
    if set(out) == {'error'}:
        assert out == {'error':'input'}, out
        return
    assert set(out) == {'cases','channels'}, set(out)
    for c in out['cases']:
        assert set(c) == CASE_KEYS, set(c)
        assert isinstance(c['name'],str) and isinstance(c['stream'],int)
        assert c['state'] in ('ok','timeout','closed','send_error'), c['state']
        assert isinstance(c['at'],int) and 0 <= c['at'] <= 2**63-1
        for k in ('frames','request_frames','payload_bytes','response_frames','origin_count'):
            assert isinstance(c[k],int) and not isinstance(c[k],bool) and c[k] >= 0, (k,c[k])
        assert fp_ok(c['sent']) and fp_ok(c['received']) and fp_ok(c['response_body'])
        assert isinstance(c['flags'],list) and c['flags'] == sorted(set(c['flags']))
    for ch in out['channels']:
        assert set(ch) == CHAN_KEYS, set(ch)
        assert fp_ok(ch['bytes'])
        assert isinstance(ch['committed'],list)
        prev = 0
        for v in ch['committed']:
            assert isinstance(v,int) and v >= prev; prev = v
        assert ch['error'] is None or (set(ch['error']) == {'kind','offset'}
                                       and ch['error']['kind'] in ('syntax','incomplete')
                                       and isinstance(ch['error']['offset'],int))
        for q in ch['requests']:
            assert set(q) == REQ_KEYS, set(q)
            for k in ('start','end','host_count'):
                assert isinstance(q[k],int) and not isinstance(q[k],bool)
            assert fp_ok(q['method']) and fp_ok(q['target']) and fp_ok(q['host'])
            assert fp_ok(q['headers']) and fp_ok(q['body']) and fp_ok(q['trailers'])
            assert q['framing'] in ('none','length','chunked')
            assert q['owner'] is None or isinstance(q['owner'],str)
            assert q['flags'] == sorted(set(q['flags']))
            total = 0
            for entry in q['owners']:
                assert isinstance(entry,list) and len(entry) == 2
                assert entry[0] is None or isinstance(entry[0],str)
                assert isinstance(entry[1],int) and entry[1] > 0
                total += entry[1]
            if q['end'] > q['start']:
                assert total == q['end']-q['start'], (total, q)

def gen(rng):
    doc = {"seed": rng.choice(['','s','seed-1','a.b_c']),
           "definitions": [],
           "timeout_ms": rng.choice([1,5,1000,10**9]),
           "cases": [], "events": [], "channels": []}
    names = []
    for i in range(rng.randrange(0,4)):
        name = 'c%d'%i
        names.append(name)
        frames = []
        for j in range(rng.randrange(0,4)):
            kind = rng.choice(['headers','data','datagram','sleep'])
            if kind == 'headers':
                if rng.random() < .5:
                    frames.append({"Type":"headers","headers_kv":{":method":"GET",":authority":"h",":path":"/"},
                                   **({"End_Stream": rng.random()<.5} if rng.random()<.5 else {})})
                else:
                    frames.append({"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":path","/x"]],
                                   "End_Stream": rng.random()<.5})
            elif kind in ('data','datagram'):
                frames.append({"Type":kind,"data_to_transfered":"payload%d"%j,
                               "End_Stream": rng.random()<.6})
            else:
                frames.append({"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":rng.randrange(0,10)})
        doc['cases'].append({"name":name,"frames":frames,
                             "expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}})
    for i in range(rng.randrange(0,6)):
        kind = rng.choice(['headers','data','close'])
        if kind == 'close':
            doc['events'].append({"at":rng.randrange(0,20),"kind":"close"})
        elif kind == 'headers':
            doc['events'].append({"at":rng.randrange(0,20),"kind":"headers",
                                  "stream":rng.randrange(0,12),
                                  "fields":[[":status","200"]],
                                  "end":rng.random()<.5})
        else:
            doc['events'].append({"at":rng.randrange(0,20),"kind":"data",
                                  "stream":rng.randrange(0,12),
                                  "data":"resp","end":rng.random()<.5})
    for i in range(rng.randrange(0,3)):
        parts = []
        for j in range(rng.randrange(0,4)):
            owner = rng.choice(names+[None]) if names else None
            parts.append({"case":owner,"data":rng.choice([
                "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n"%rng.randrange(0,4),
                "abc", "", "POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n2\r\nhi\r\n0\r\n\r\n",
                "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n", "junk\n"] )})
        doc['channels'].append({"name":"e%d"%i,"parts":parts})
    if rng.random() < .3:
        doc['definitions'] = [["p","b'abc'"],["q","p*2"],["r","q[0:3]+b'!'"]]
    return doc

rng = random.Random(1234)
errors = 0; ok = 0
for i in range(400):
    doc = gen(rng)
    raw = json.dumps(doc)
    p = run_raw(raw.encode())
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[-500:], raw[:200])
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    try:
        check_doc(doc, out)
    except AssertionError as e:
        FAIL.append((i, str(e)[:200], raw[:200])); print('FAIL', i, str(e)[:200]); continue
    if set(out) == {'error'}: errors += 1
    else: ok += 1
print('valid outputs', ok, 'input errors', errors, 'FAILURES', len(FAIL))
